title: Oracle at Delphi as a burning methane seep

tellings.quote: oracle at Deli was a methane seep, a burning methane seep.

plain: The famous oracle at Delphi in ancient Greece, where a priestess gave prophecies, sat on a methane seep, a spot where natural gas leaked from the ground and burned. A researcher named Geoffrey Drumm says this on the show without naming a source. If so, the sacred site would have been built around a natural fire coming out of the earth.
